prompt: A wide weathered concrete wall in a rail yard underpass, covered edge to edge in layers of protest graffiti: stenciled raised fists, a crossed-out surveillance camera, dripping spray-paint tags, ink splatters and torn wheatpaste posters peeling at the corners. The single word "UNBROKEN" stenciled once in red.
